title: Hikvision DS-AE-DC2018-D1 Dashcam 2MP 1080P Car DVR Camera | WiFi, Night Vision, G-Sensor & Parking Monitoring
body_html:
The dashcam supports loop recording, automatically overwriting the oldest footage when the TF card storage (up to 128GB) is full, ensuring continuous recording without manual intervention. In case of sudden impact or strong vibration, the built-in G-Sensor automatically locks and saves the relevant video file to prevent it from being overwritten. With parking monitoring, your vehicle remains protected even when parked. The camera automatically records if motion or vibration is detected. The built-in microphone and speaker support audio recording and playback.

Key Features

2MP Full HD 1080P video recording

102° horizontal and 122° diagonal wide-angle coverage

Loop recording with automatic overwrite

Night vision for low-light recording

Parking monitoring mode

Built-in G-Sensor for collision detection and emergency video lock

Locked footage protected from overwrite

Built-in microphone and speaker for audio recording

Built-in WiFi for smartphone connectivity

Mobile app support for live view, playback, and settings control

TF card support up to 128GB
